title: I turn ambitious ideas into working products
tagline: I partner with founders and teams to define the right problem, design the experience, and ship production-ready products built around measurable outcomes.

apps.name: Visicart

apps.next: Turn Cadence embed into a paid pilot. Define pricing for the next brand.

apps.name: GeoAI

apps.name: StrideIQ
